title: Food Security in India
subtitle: Ensuring Food for All
subject: Social Science
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the concept and dimensions of Food Security.
Analyze why food security is necessary in a developing country like India.
Evaluate the role of the Public Distribution System (PDS) and buffer stocks.
Identify the food insecure sections of society.

ai_context.learning_goal: To provide students with a comprehensive understanding of food security in India, its challenges, and government initiatives, integrated with cultural awareness of food as a fundamental human right.
common_misconceptions: Food security only means producing enough food.
The Public Distribution System (PDS) is flawless and reaches everyone.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If a student struggles, ask them: 'Imagine a drought hits a village. Even if the country has enough food, how do we ensure the villagers can afford and access it?'
